---
title: "bayesim simulation report"
format: html
params:
  result_path: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
stopifnot(!is.null(params$result_path))
result <- readRDS(params$result_path)
```

# Study design

```{r study-design}
tryCatch({
  cat("Config fingerprint:", result$config_fingerprint, "\n\n")
  cat("Total tasks:", length(result$task_results), "\n\n")
  if (!is.null(result$task_grid)) {
    cat("Task grid:", nrow(result$task_grid), "rows x",
        ncol(result$task_grid), "cols\n\n")
    print(knitr::kable(head(result$task_grid)))
  }
  if (!is.null(result$timing) && !is.null(result$timing$total)) {
    cat("\nTotal compute time:", round(result$timing$total, 2), "s\n")
  }
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("Study design section failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
})
```

# Performance measures

```{r performance-measures}
tryCatch({
  pm <- bayesim::performance_measures(result)
  if (!is.null(pm) && nrow(pm) > 0L) {
    print(knitr::kable(pm))
  } else {
    cat("No performance measures available.\n")
  }
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("Performance measures section failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
})
```

# Parameter recovery

```{r parameter-recovery}
tryCatch({
  df <- result$summary
  truth_cols <- grep("^truth__", names(df), value = TRUE)
  estimands <- sub("^truth__", "", truth_cols)
  estimands <- estimands[vapply(estimands, function(p) {
    paste0("posterior_summary__mean__", p) %in% names(df)
  }, logical(1))]
  if (length(estimands) == 0L) {
    cat("No estimands with truth + posterior summary available.\n")
  }
  for (est in estimands) {
    cat("\n##", est, "\n\n")
    p <- bayesim::plot_recovery(result, est)
    print(p)
  }
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("Parameter recovery section failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
})
```

# Coverage

```{r coverage}
tryCatch({
  p <- bayesim::plot_coverage(result)
  print(p)
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("Coverage section failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
})
```

# SBC

```{r sbc}
tryCatch({
  ranks <- bayesim::sbc_ranks(result)
  if (!is.null(ranks) && nrow(ranks) > 0L) {
    p <- bayesim::plot_rank_ecdf(ranks)
    print(p)
  } else {
    cat("No rank metric was computed; skipping SBC section.\n")
  }
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("SBC section failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
})
```
